# agenco_allowed_origins (Resource)

Manages the vendor-level CORS allow-list. This is a singleton for the whole vendor, so declare it at most once. Destroying the resource clears the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Vendor-wide singleton — declare it at most once across your configuration.
resource "agenco_allowed_origins" "default" {
  origins = [
    "https://storefront.example.com",
    "https://admin.example.com",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `origins` (Set of String) Origins allowed to call the Frontegg API, for example https://app.example.com.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Vendor ID.
